sources.locator: SS1.1-1.3 (PDF pp. 3-4), SS1.5-1.10 (PDF pp. 6-8), SS2.5-2.27 (PDF pp. 9-19) and SS3.1-3.9 (PDF pp. 19-24); SS2.28 for the one-color nil-Hecke example.

contents.name: SS1.1-1.3: quiver representations, graded complete flags, x-stable flags, the incidence variety F-tilde_y, its proper GV-equivariant projection to E_V and the tautological quotient line bundles
SS1.5-1.6: the canonical module F_V = Ext(L_y-vee, D), its graded SV-module structure and the Yoneda action of Z_V
SS1.7-1.8: convolution algebra on Z_V = F-tilde_V x_EV F-tilde_V, faithfulness of its action on H^GV_*(F-tilde_V), and the canonical isomorphism Z_V = H^GV_*(Z_V)
SS1.9-1.10: the grading shifts delta Z, delta F and the source-first composition and shift notation
SS2.5-2.9: relative-position orbits in F_V x F_V, the closed strata Z^x and Z^{<=x}, and the convolution inclusions Z^{<=x} * Z^{<=y} subset Z^{<=xy}
SS2.10-2.19: torus-localization data, the Euler classes Lambda_w, eu(n_V,w), eu(d_V,w,ws), and the localizations of H^T_*(F-tilde_V) and H^T_*(Z_V)
SS2.20-2.21: the fixed-point convolution formulas psi_w',w * psi_w = Lambda_w psi_w' and the proof that the convolution action is faithful
SS2.22-2.25: the elements 1_i, kappa_i(k), sigma_i(l), their explicit action on F_V and the grading rules deg sigma_i(l) = a_i(l)
SS2.26-2.27: Z_V is a free left graded F_V-module of rank m! with basis the closure classes (cell proof left to the reader)
SS2.28(a): for I = {i} and nu = m i, F_V = P_V and Z_V is the nil-Hecke ring; (b) the empty-arrow many-color case
SS3.1-3.3: the KLR algebra R_V, its faithful polynomial representation on Q_V = F_V, the presentation with Q_{i,l}, and the generator normalization tau_i(l) = (-1)^{h_i(l)} sigma_i(l)
SS3.4-3.6: PBW for R_V and the unique graded isomorphism R_V = delta Z_V intertwining the representations
SS3.8-3.9: the weighted Euler-class identity eu(Z^s) eu(Z^w) = eu(Z^{sw}) Lambda_x used for the top coefficient of a product of elementary classes
SS3.3(c): the braid relation with the polynomial correction (Q(kappa_{l+2},kappa_{l+1}) - Q(kappa_l,kappa_{l+1}))/(kappa_{l+2}-kappa_l)
SS2.7: an explicit two-color example of the relative-position strata and their closures
SS4: canonical bases, projective graded R_V-modules and the KLR categorification conjecture
contents.reason: Not consumed by this pair: the Ext realization needs only SS1-SS3, and the global-basis consumers belong to the separate ten-pair KLR family.
